method: Each curated row is compared with the price its own official product page printed in this run, and — for Shopify storefronts — with the seller's own variant feed for that exact product. A stored single price, or the full stored range, must appear in one of those sources; a price is never attributed from a cross-sell tile. Weights count as reproduced only on an exact gram string.
